item.title: GitHut – Programming Languages and GitHub (2014)
item.description:
📝 GitHut - Programming Languages and GitHub GitHut A small place to discover languages in GitHub Top active languages A split by language view of active repositories view by total amount # % view by percentage on total GitHut GitHut is an attempt to visualize and explore the complexity of the universe of programming languages used across the repositories hosted on GitHub. GitHub Archive dataset is also available via Google BigQuery. The quantitative data used in GitHut is collected from GitHub Archive.
🔗 Read more: https://githut.info/

item.title: Over-Regulation Is Doubling the Cost by Peter Reinhardt
item.description:
📝 We’re unintentionally blocking the very things that would improve our environment. We’ve become a society that blocks all things, and we need to be a society that builds great things every day. A regulator faces little cost to moving incredibly cautiously, but a major cost if they approve something that triggers activist pushback.
🔗 Read more: https://rein.pk/over-regulation-is-doubling-the-cost
